{{Quote|Colonel Finley commands the Republic's Fifth Expeditionary Force. He's agreed to assist our operation.|[[Warren Sedoru]]|<ref name="TOR:DEW" />}}
The '''Fifth Expeditionary Force''' was one of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Expeditionary Forces|Expeditionary Forces]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Around [[3642 BBY]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Finley]] and his men from the Fifth Expeditionary Force aided the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] and [[Warren Sedoru]] in their [[Mission to Balmorra (Hunt for the Sith Emperor)|search for]] a [[prototype cloaking device]].<ref name="TOR:TA">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Tactical Advantages|Balmorra}}</ref>
